docs.question: Compare the average number of available bikes in hours with precipitation versus dry hours.
docs.answer: Hours with precipitation averaged 11.65 available bikes, compared with 11.84 in dry hours—about 0.19 fewer bikes during precipitation.
docs.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN had_precipitation THEN 'precipitation' ELSE 'dry' END AS condition, AVG(avg_available_bikes) AS average_available_bikes FROM marts.agg_station_hourly WHERE had_precipitation IS NOT NULL GROUP BY had_precipitation ORDER BY had_precipitation DESC LIMIT 200
